chain_words.nuance: to test something briefly to see whether it works
to examine something systematically before using it widely
to start using a new practice or technology as one's own
to welcome a new idea or technology with enthusiasm
to combine a new technology fully into existing systems and society

explanation: These words all describe taking up a new technology, from a brief trial to a full integration into society.

usage_notes.difference: 'Adopt' means starting to use something as one's own practice; 'integrate' means combining it fully with existing systems and structures.
